purpose: Form NCLAT-7 is used for recording the deposition of a witness before the Appellate Tribunal.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Record the deposition of a witness in Form NCLAT-7.
Initial each page of the deposition by the Members constituting the Bench.
Point out corrections, if any, by the witness.
Carry out and duly initial corrections if the Bench is satisfied.
Append a note at the bottom of the deposition if the Bench is not satisfied with corrections.
checklist: Form NCLAT-7 ready for recording witness deposition
Witness available for deposition and to point out corrections
Bench members ready to initial each page
Means to append a note at the bottom if corrections are not satisfied
watch: Corrections pointed out by the witness are only carried out if the Bench is satisfied.
